title: DHII Engine architecture freeze with Tasks 01-07 creation foundations and persistence seam
summary: Tasks 01-07 are accepted locally. The repo now has a frozen DHII Engine roadmap, canonical creation catalogs, explainable aptitude composition, a typed creation draft, standard DHII characteristic generation, bounded starting-package projection, and an additive persistence/migration seam for engine-backed creation state. Validation is green locally, including full make ci, host/UI coverage, schema-compatibility tests, and coverage-policy checks.
accepted_scope: DHII Engine roadmap and ordered task decomposition
typed home-world, background, and role catalogs with rulebook-backed previews
deterministic aptitude composition with explicit unresolved-choice handling
typed creation draft aggregate and safe recomposition
standard DHII characteristic generation with transient Influence
bounded starting-package projection into the legacy Character snapshot
additive persisted DHII engine state for canonical selections, supported choice slots, starting rolls, fallback aptitudes, and characteristic-generation provenance
legacy-compatible import/export migration from schema 1 to schema 2
Task 01-07 regression hardening and proof-bundle updates
rejected_scope: engine-first persistence cutover replacing the legacy Character snapshot
full background and role package automation beyond the supported bounded projection surface
residual_risks: the app still lacks the staged engine-backed creation/edit flow
Influence is still not a first-class public field on the persisted Character snapshot
web does not yet consume the new creation engine seam directly
required_followups: Replace manual creation illusions with an engine-backed staged creation/edit flow
Harden progression and dependency evaluation against persisted engine state
Decide the longer-term migration path from additive engine state to engine-first persistence
tested_in_this_environment: full make ci including host/UI coverage and coverage policy
not_verified_in_this_environment: manual visual review of the new engine state through the UI
